description: This file contains a helper class 'Sample' used in sample code for the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides utility methods for file handling, chart rendering, logging, and sample management within the PhpSpreadsheet project.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Helper class providing utility functions for sample code in PhpSpreadsheet, including file management, chart rendering, and logging.

methods.name: isCli
methods.description: Checks if the script is running in CLI mode.

methods.name: getScriptFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the currently executing script.

methods.name: isIndex
methods.description: Determines if the current script is the index page.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the page title based on the script context.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Retrieves an array of all known sample files categorized.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a Spreadsheet to files in specified formats, optionally with charts.

methods.name: isDirOrMkdir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists or attempts to create it.

methods.name: getTemporaryFolder
methods.description: Returns the temporary folder path, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Generates a filename for sample output with specified extension.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a log message, formatted for CLI or web.

methods.name: renderChart
methods.description: Renders a chart to an image file and displays it if not in CLI.

methods.name: logCalculationResult
methods.description: Logs the result of a calculation from a worksheet.

methods.name: logEndingNotes
methods.description: Logs memory usage and other ending notes.

methods.name: logWrite
methods.description: Logs details about a write operation.

methods.name: logRead
methods.description: Logs details about a read operation.
